## Checkpoint: task complete

**PR:** https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/59

**What was done:** Read both real audits (AUDIT-000009/ChatGPT, AUDIT-000010/Z.AI) in full, plus all 6 analysed source files and the 3 service-layer files the routes delegate to (which neither audit actually inspected) — that extra layer mattered, since it refuted one audit claim and reframed the severity of another.

**19 distinct findings, cross-referenced:**
- **2** raised by both audits (polygon CHECK constraint, duplicated Supabase admin-client) — highest confidence
- **15** confirmed or partially confirmed, each assigned to one of 7 implementation phases
- **2** confirmed but deliberately deferred (org_id FK convention, RLS boilerplate dedup) — both are codebase-wide convention questions, not Wave-143-specific security gaps, fixing them here would create more inconsistency, not less
- **2** refuted against real code: ChatGPT's "no passcode-login audit logging" claim — the logging exists one layer down in `passcode-login-service.ts`, which ChatGPT's audit never read; and its "no governance-metadata linkage" claim — contradicted by the files' own substantial headers
- Only **1** finding rated `high` severity: `failure-event/route.ts` has zero rate-limiting or body-size control at the route level (both audits caught this independently)

**Implementation plan:** phase_0 (this evaluation, marked done) + 7 real phases — shared IP-extraction/admin-client utils, a drizzle migration closing the interior-schema FK/CHECK/updated_at gaps, email validation reusing the existing `isValidEmail()` util, failure-event rate-limiting, structured error codes, SSO/failure-event audit logging, security response headers.

**One real gap I caught and fixed along the way:** the plan's required filename (`SECURITY_AUDIT_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_2026-07-25.yaml`) didn't match `auto_phase_continuation.py`'s `PLAN_GLOB` pattern (`*_PHASE_PLAN_*.yaml`), so the cron dispatcher would never have discovered it. Widened it to `PLAN_GLOBS` (same technique the Wiring Engine task used for a different naming mismatch) — verified the new glob finds all 6 plan files with nothing unrelated swept in.

All 4 spec success criteria pass; both files are registered in `MASTER_INDEX.yaml` and via `superboss-register.py register-knowledge`. No downstream code fixes were implemented, per the task's own constraint — phases 1-7 are left for auto-continuation to dispatch after merge.
